claim.value: The target property is an increased probability of exports exceeding one hour under comparable workloads, rather than a shift in median export duration.
claim.scope: Definition of the property investigated across deployment revisions.

provenance.rationale: P002 supplies the property definition, workload qualification and distinction from median duration.

signal_basis.value: Observe each revision's export count, fraction exceeding one hour and uncertainty, recording workload and load. Classify against prespecified acceptable and elevated ranges using comparable end-to-end timing; trials stopped before one hour have unknown threshold outcomes.
signal_basis.scope: Measurement and classification of the defined tail-rate property across revisions under comparable workloads.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans specify the measured tail frequency, uncertainty, classification ranges, timing comparability and treatment of incomplete trials.
No unresolved empirical relation is needed to warrant this definition of the investigated property.

rationale: The operation and signal directly operationalize the probability of exceeding one hour under comparable workloads. This licenses the claim within its definitional scope; the claim does not assert that an increase has actually been established.
uncertainty: Sampling uncertainty affects revision classification, but does not undermine the stated definition of the target property.
